title: Peisar SSG
description: Configuration schema for Peisar.toml, the configuration file used by the Peisar static site generator to define site metadata, directory paths, and the development server.

description.description: A brief description of the site.

author.description: The author's name, optionally including an email address, for example: "Jane Doe <jane.doe@example.com>".

directories.description: Directories for markdown content, asset files, theme files, and build output.

root_dir.description: The root directory of the project. Defaults to "cwd" (the current working directory).

contents_dir.description: The directory containing markdown files, relative to the project root. Defaults to "contents".

public_dir.description: The directory containing asset files (images, JavaScript, CSS), relative to the project root. Defaults to "public".

data_dir.description: The directory containing data files, relative to the project root. Defaults to "data".

out_dir.description: The build output directory, relative to the project root. Defaults to ".peisar".

port.description: The port of the local development server. Defaults to 3838.

host.description: The host of the local development server. Defaults to "127.0.0.1".
